description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
Fixed
- when your journal's address changes, the solstone app now switches to the new address without pairing again, as long as it can still reach your journal another way after the change. this needs your journal to be updated too.
